HashMap.UseCase: Fast lookups, no need for order
HashMap.MemoryUsage: Less (no extra links for order tracking)
HashMap.NullKeysValues: Allows 1 null key, multiple null values
QuickNotes: Use HashMap when order does NOT matter

LinkedHashMap.UseCase: When order matters (e.g., caching, API responses)
LinkedHashMap.MemoryUsage: Slightly more (stores order via doubly linked list)
LinkedHashMap.NullKeysValues: Allows 1 null key, multiple null values
LinkedHashMap.BestFor: Ordered data storage, LRU caches, JSON responses
QuickNotes: Best for JSON responses and LRU Caching

WhenToUseHashMap: Fast lookups without worrying about order
Large datasets where performance is critical
WhenToUseLinkedHashMap: Preserving the order of elements (e.g., JSON API response, LRU cache)
